# Contributing to AI Terminal Chat

Thank you for contributing to AI Terminal Chat.

## Using AI

Generative AI tools may be used during development and when preparing contributions to this project.

If generative AI is used to produce a substantial portion of a contribution, please disclose that use in the pull request description. Include the AI service and, when practical, the model used.

AI-assisted contributions are subject to the same review, testing, security, accessibility, and quality requirements as any other contribution. Contributors remain responsible for understanding, reviewing, testing, and validating code generated with AI before submitting it.

For this project, particular attention should be given to:

* Security boundaries around filesystem and terminal tools.
* API keys and other credentials.
* Accessibility and screen-reader behavior.
* Tests and regression coverage.
* Compatibility across supported providers and platforms.

Use of AI does not replace normal code review or testing.
